decisions.reason: As a simple, recurring care product tied to the installed base of wood floors, it supports customer retention and the firm's system offering at low strategic risk.
After the withdrawal of the maintenance oil line, this care product for oiled floors remains a relevant lifecycle accessory that fits the firm's focus on complete floor-care solutions.
High-density underlay foam still complements the core flooring business, but accessories in the underlay category face somewhat higher review risk after earlier portfolio pruning.
The oak parquet line is tightly aligned with the firm's core manufacturing capabilities, brand, and growth strategy, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
